test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 10th December 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Films based on books are more ______ than original screenplays.
solution:
The correct answer is, 'Popular'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Videos and movies grab audiences' attention better than books. 
 
• They are the common talking point, making them popular.
 
• Screenplays mean to showcase the exact stories without any diversion.
 
• And since Films are made in such a way that they are to be liked, *Films based on books are more popular than the original screenplays*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Better, films and original screenplays have their own objective and target audience. The comparison of being better is absurd. Better is used to comparison in two similar things. For example, *Harry Potter was a better wizard than Ron Weasley.*
 
• Favourite, depending on the audience. Some people do prefer screenplays over films, it's irrelevant here.
 
• Different, since films based on books and screenplays have the same source, they are not that different, it's illogical.
